public_body: Roxbury Prep Charter School Board Of Trustees
overall: Complaint on notice specificity and convening procedures was untimely and declined. The Board violated the Open Meeting Law by discussing topics in executive session that did not fit any executive session purpose; minutes release and training were ordered.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that the Board's meeting notices for twelve meetings (2018-2020) gave insufficiently specific executive session topics.
allegations.key_passage: The allegation that the notices for the twelve meetings at issue failed to include sufficiently specific executive session topics was discoverable on the date each notice was posted, or, at the latest, the date of each meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to follow proper procedures before convening in executive session at twelve meetings.
allegations.key_passage: Likewise, because the Board moved to enter executive session during an open session in each instance relevant here, any allegation that the Board failed to follow proper procedures for convening in executive session was discoverable on the date of each meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board met in executive session at twelve meetings without a proper executive session purpose; the AG found several discussions improper.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by discussing topics in executive session that were not appropriate for executive session.

allegations.summary: Request for further review raised additional allegations not included in the original complaint filed with the Board.
allegations.key_passage: The request for further review raises additional allegations which we decline to review because they were not raised in an original complaint filed with the Board.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Release in their entirety the executive session minutes for January 31, March 28, and May 30, 2019.
Release, subject to appropriate redaction, the executive session minutes for September 25 and November 21, 2019, and January 30, March 26, June 25, August 20, and September 23, 2020.
Certify to the AG within 30 days that the relevant executive session minutes have been released.
Each Board member must review the Attorney General's executive session training video and the Board must certify this within 60 days.
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
